name: Polytheism
overview: Scripture clearly reveals the reality and error of polytheism, emphasizing the exclusive worship of the one true God. God commands in Exodus 20:3 that no other gods are to be placed before Him, underscoring His unique sovereignty. The presence of 'strange gods' or images, as seen in Genesis 31:19 and the call to remove them in Genesis 35:2-4, illustrates the persistent temptation toward idolatry among God's people. Additionally, the plural language in Genesis 1:26 and 3:22 reflects the complex unity of God rather than endorsing multiple deities, affirming monotheism as foundational to biblical truth.
